title: The worst defect found in nineteen rounds: a two-step skill answered 0 where the truth was 3, and every instrument in the project said PASS
how_it_was_found: the round was scheduled to audit multi-step answers for the first time. The probe returned 0 immediately, before any audit ran.

the_defect.execution:
step 0 printed 'a
b
z
' to its own receipt; step 1 ran with stdin=DEVNULL, wc got EOF, printed '0' and exited 0
the_defect.cause: cli_exec steps are executed independently with stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL. There is no dataflow between steps.
the_defect.control: the same intent recorded as ONE cli_pipeline step answers 3, correctly

why_every_instrument_missed_it.carrier: confinement was real, the live workspace was untouched, and wc exiting 0 on empty input is correct behaviour. Nothing to report.
why_every_instrument_missed_it.verifier: a genuinely empty file also yields 0 / STDOUT_INTEGER_VERIFIED:0. The broken answer and the honest empty answer are byte-identical in the receipt.
why_every_instrument_missed_it.derivation_audit: returns NOT_AUDITABLE__MULTI_STEP. It refuses rather than catches.
why_every_instrument_missed_it.shape_audit: SHAPE_MATCHES_THE_GOAL -- a count was asked for and a count came back.
why_every_instrument_missed_it.conclusion: the wrong answer is indistinguishable from the right one, and from a legitimately empty one, using every check this project has.

the_honest_answer_is_also_unauditable.implication: r48's headline, 23/23 ANSWER_MATCHES_ITS_SOURCE, was 23 single-command answers. No multi-step answer has ever been auditable in this project, and none had ever been attempted before this round.

the_fix.where: compile time, before the trace is elevated and before donor deletion
the_fix.rule: a step list containing more than one cli_exec is refused
the_fix.reason_given_to_the_caller: cli_exec steps run with stdin closed, so a second cli_exec cannot read the first one's output. Record the pipeline as one cli_pipeline step, or the two reads as separate skills.
the_fix.why_compile_time: the mistake is made when the trace is recorded. Refusing there costs nothing, and the alternative is a silently wrong answer.

corroboration_2026.rtk-ai/rtk issue 4091: 'wc does not read stdin -- silent false zero on redirect and pipe ... when no file operand is given, it prints 0 and exits 0, making it indistinguishable from a real empty file'
corroboration_2026.D10Scot/Dispatcharr PR 240: 'the redirect discards the sentence explaining the emptiness, which leaves empty-because-it-worked and empty-because-it-failed indistinguishable ... a pipe throws away the exit code ... | head, | wc -l and | grep all launder a failure into a plausible empty answer'
corroboration_2026.note: the same defect class, in production, in the same week, found independently. It is not specific to this project and it is not fixed by better evaluation of final outputs.

the_standing_claim_again: learn once and it is permanent, therefore solve everything on a computer. This round: a skill that was taught, qualified, stored and permanently recallable produced an answer of 0 where the truth was 3, with a clean bill of health from every check. Permanence faithfully reproduces whatever the demonstration actually captured, including a demonstration that captured two steps which never talked to each other.
what_is_real: the pipeline layer answers correctly when the trace records a pipeline
the defect is now refused at compile time rather than answered
the refusal states the cause and the remedy
what_is_not_real: that a correct-looking answer is evidence of a correct pipeline
that auditability covers multi-step work -- it does not, by explicit refusal
